share_convention.name: NOMINAL_SHARES_REVERSE_FUTURE_YAHOO_SPLITS_V1
share_convention.ohlc: Yahoo OHLC multiplied by product of split ratios strictly after row date through snapshot end.
share_convention.volume: Yahoo split-adjusted Volume divided by that same future split factor.
share_convention.dividend: Yahoo Dividends multiplied by future factor and same-day split ratio: per pre-action share.
share_convention.split: Yahoo Stock Splits; zero means no event and maps to ratio 1.
share_convention.adj_close: Retained unmodified for audit only; forbidden as an execution price or full-history signal adjustment.
share_convention.causality: Reverse normalization removes future splits from nominal units; strategy uses only observations <= previous close. Vendor revisions/repair are ex-post, not point-in-time evidence.
share_convention.limitation: Complete and correct Yahoo splits/normalization are assumptions; no official company-action reconciliation. Simultaneous dividend/split convention is research-only.

universe_bias: 2026 official whitelist applied retrospectively; composition and survivorship look-ahead, not historically deployable point-in-time results.
repair_provenance: Preserved exact yfinance repair=True daily output including Repaired?. Library may internally use intraday reconstruction; strategy/cache inputs are daily only. Vendor repair is ex-post and may be wrong.
